name: B10-0192/2025 (S&D) – Democracy and human rights in Thailand, notably the lese-majesty law and the deportation of Uyghur refugees
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on democracy and human rights in Thailand, notably the lese-majesty law and the deportation of Uyghur refugees
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking Thailand to change its laws and practices. It wants Thailand to scrap or amend the law that punishes people for criticising the monarchy, and to release everyone held under it. It also condemns Thailand for sending 40 Uyghur refugees back to China and asks for the remaining detainees to be protected. It says these human rights issues should affect the EU's trade talks with Thailand. This is an opinion; it does not change any law itself.

- Thailand is urged to repeal its royal insult law and free those jailed under it.
- Thailand is condemned for deporting Uyghur refugees to China; remaining detainees must be protected.
- The EU Commission should make trade talks with Thailand depend on these human rights reforms.
